IMPLEMENTED SCOPE
Shared native full-screen Dialog preset-selection page for Photo Live new/existing
project defaults and batch presets in Camera, Photo Live and Downloaded. Large
cards show effect/name/current check. Effects use the actual local NCP through
PresetPreviewRenderer with the existing unified or user-replaced template.
Local catalog/validation/rendering run asynchronously; visible rows load lazily,
with ListView virtualization and a bounded single-worker queue/image cache.
Loading/empty/error feedback and retry are supported. Unsupported formats show
their reason and are disabled; choosing a preset rereads and validates its NCP.
Selection dismisses then returns to the parent. Defaults fill the same form;
batch selection still requires existing processing confirmation. Back/cancel keeps
the original preset, project form and selected photos. No project is auto-created,
and no rendering batch is started by simply opening/selecting in this picker.
Source/generation guards discard obsolete callbacks and private bitmaps. Safe
areas, UiPalette light/dark colours, adaptive widths, 48dp Back and existing
reduced-motion-aware page transitions are used. This is local-only: no network,
camera connection, original acquisition or camera writing is performed by the page.
Live/Downloaded photo counts are followed immediately by Filter dropdowns. The
menu contains only a checkable Starred item. Enabled headers show a star icon
and Starred dropdown; disabling restores all photos.

CHECK SCOPE
UI-only change: no new host test and no existing host/protocol suite rerun.
The prior 0.9.0 checks are not presented as runs for 0.9.1.
No prior 0.9.0 test totals are counted in this run.

NATIVE EMULATOR
Earlier acb candidate, not final 8da:
VisualQA new-project form opens default page. Real Tone/Identity template effects
are visibly distinct with names; None has the current check. Tone selection
returns to the original form retaining VisualQA. Reopening/Back preserves Tone.
Starting synthetic Live receives shot4 as one original plus effect; Live stops.
Existing-default page shows Tone current; selecting None returns automatically.
Live star filter with zero results can be disabled to show one photo again.
Downloaded raw4 selection -> visual batch picker -> Tone returns to one-photo
confirmation. Cancelling keeps the original selected photo; reopening/Back also
retains it. No actual batch processing is started.
Dark/font1.3, wm984x2190 and landscape scroll to card names with animator scale0.
Candidate screenshots use v091 preset-picker, batch-picker, filter-menu,
picker-dark and picker-landscape names; most have been visually checked.
Final 8da differs from acb only in full-screen Dialog dark system-bar handling
(theme and WindowInsetsController).
